entries.module.title: History card
entries.page.title: History card
entries.title: History card
entries.window.no_dates: The {window} up to the snapshot the card is as of.
entries.banner.private.label: PRIVATE
entries.banner.private.text: This is your own copy of your History card, with the deal entries it is counted from. Do not forward this file: it is not the card to send. The card others get carries the counts only.
entries.lead.own: Your agent helped you buy and sell with other people and their agents. This card is what others can learn about your agent, only as much as you choose to share. The card they get has exactly these counts.
entries.lead.shared: This is the History card an agent's holder shares: counts of their deals in a window, and nothing about any one deal.
entries.holder.person: A person's agent · a person stands behind it, as they declare
entries.holder.node: A node's agent · its operator declares it
entries.total.lead.own: deals where you had to come through went as agreed.
entries.total.lead.shared: deals where the holder had to come through went as agreed.
entries.total.none: No deal in this window counts on the card.
entries.counts.statement: These counts are the holder's own statement. This page does not hold the deal entries they are counted from, so it could not recount them.
entries.counts.statement.entries: This copy carries the deal entries but not {what}, so the counts were not recounted: they are the holder's own statement.
entries.counts.recomputed: Recounted here from the deal entries in this copy: every count matches.
entries.sizes.note: Each currency on its own: sizes in different currencies are never added up or converted.
entries.sizes.none: No counted deal, so no size range.
entries.heading.happened: The other side agreed it happened
entries.happened.note: Stamped by both sides means the book holds the other side's own record of the deal. A receipt only means the book holds the holder's own receipt, not the other side's record. No record means the book holds neither. A missing record is not a failure.
entries.disputes.outcomes: How they ended, of {of}: still open {open} · for {who} {for} · against {who} {against} · split {split} · no finding {no_finding} · withdrawn {withdrawn}
entries.disputes.forums: Where, of {of}: a rule both sides agreed {auto} · the network {network} · the payment rail {rail} · somewhere else {external}
entries.counts.what.own: What counts: deals where you had to come through for someone: pay afterwards, deliver, show up, describe it right.
entries.counts.what.shared: What counts: deals where the holder had to come through for someone: pay afterwards, deliver, show up, describe it right.
entries.counts.not_counted.own: Not counted: {n} of {of} deals in the window, shop purchases paid up front. Paying a shop up front takes no doing; anyone can. They stay in your book.
entries.counts.not_counted.shared: Not counted: {n} of {of} deals in the window, shop purchases paid up front. They stay in the holder's book.
entries.counts.class_missing: {n} of {of} counted deals don't say what kind of party they were with. They are counted.
entries.counts.not_on.own: Not on it: your name, what you bought or sold, what you paid, who the other side was, anything outside the window.
entries.counts.not_on.shared: Not on it: the holder's name, what they bought or sold, what they paid, who the other side was, anything outside the window.
entries.proves.sealed: The card says which snapshot of the holder's log it is as of, and this page checked it against the snapshot carried beside it.
entries.proves.add_up: Every count sits inside its total, and the totals agree with each other.
entries.proves.recomputed: The counts recount from the deal entries in this copy.
entries.doesnt.who.person: Who the holder is. Only that a person stands behind the agent, as they declare.
entries.doesnt.who.node: Who runs the node. Only what its operator declares.
entries.doesnt.all: That these are all the holder's deals. It is the window the holder's policy sets, and shop purchases are not counted.
entries.doesnt.statement: That the counts are right. Without the deal entries they are the holder's own statement.
entries.doesnt.witness: That an outside witness saw the snapshot. This page does not check the witness receipt.
entries.doesnt.signature: That the holder's key signed it. This page does not check the signature.
entries.doesnt.next: What the other side will do with it. That's up to their rules. Most deal small without it and ask for more before a big one.
entries.say.what_happened.note: narrated by your agent from your records · it will offer an EvidenceBook version
entries.say.report.note: sealed and checked: the same page anyone can verify
entries.say.attach: “Attach my card when I buy or sell”
entries.refused.title: This is not a standard History card
entries.refused.lead: This card fails a check a standard card must pass, so none of its counts is shown.
entries.unreadable.title: This History card can't be read
entries.unreadable.lead: What travels beside the card can't be read, so none of its counts is shown.
entries.unverified.title: This History card did not verify
entries.unverified.lead: The file around the card did not pass this page's checks, so none of its counts is shown.
entries.checks.lead: Each check of the card, and whether this page ran it. A check that needs what the page doesn't hold says so.
entries.status.skipped: not run: an earlier check failed
entries.property.card_form: The card has exactly the members a standard card has
entries.property.counts_integral: Every count is a whole number, never a fraction or a share
entries.property.denominator: Every count carries its total, and the totals agree
entries.property.window_from_policy: The window is the one the holder's policy sets
entries.property.as_of: The card is as of the snapshot it names
entries.property.counts_recompute: The counts recount from the deal entries
entries.property.anchor_inclusion: An outside witness saw the snapshot
entries.checks.held_beside: The policy and the snapshot this page checks against are the ones carried beside the card, as the holder states them.
entries.card.not_counted: {n} of {of} deals in the window are not counted.
